How to Play Pick 4 Plus

NOTE: If the images do not appear, refresh your page or just scroll down to read the information.

  1. Choose 4 numbers from 0 to 9 or ask for a “Quick Pick” to let the machine pick random numbers for you.
  2. Select your play type:
    • Straight
    • Box
    • Straight/Box
    • Combo
    • Front Pair
    • Middle Pair
    • Back Pair
  3. Choose a Draw Time:
    • DAY
    • EVE
    • DAY & EVE

How to Win

Four numbers, each from a range of 0 to 9, will be drawn. Depending on the play type selected, you win the prize indicated by matching the numbers drawn, as shown in the following prize chart:

* ALL PRIZES ARE SUBJECT TO PARI-MUTUEL PAYOUTS. ACTUAL PRIZE WON MAY BE LESS THAN THE AMOUNTS SHOWN.
If prizes won in a drawing exceed the maximum amount set by the New Mexico Lottery Authority (NMLA), then that maximum amount will be divided and paid equally among the number of winning plays. 

For draws dated June 27, 2021, to present, each prize tier has a maximum payout amount of $125,000. If prizes won for a prize tier exceed that amount, then that amount will be divided and paid equally among the winning plays for that prize tier.

**Front Pair, Middle Pair, and/or Back Pair can be played on their own or added on to another Play Type for an additional $1 each. If played on their own, Front Pair, Middle Pair, or Back Pair plays may show asterisks in place of two of the numbers on the ticket.

Advance Play

You can select specific drawing days to play (except for the current drawing) with “Advance Play.” Just ask the clerk or mark your play slip.

Play Up to 14 Drawings with Multi Draw

Whether you play your favorite numbers or choose Quick Picks, you can play up to 14 advance drawings in a row. Simply mark the appropriate box next to MULTI DRAW on your play slip or ask the clerk for a Multi-Draw ticket.
